# Base de Conhecimento HCL Workload Automation (TWS/HWA 10.2.8) - Parte 4

## [hwa-msgcat-awsbhz008e] Troubleshooting & Mensagens de Erro
**Contexto:** [Escopo: HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 > Componente: bhz > Interface: mensagem AWSBHZ008E > Topico: troubleshooting > messages [awsbhz008e]]

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBHZ008E (severidade: error, familia AWSBHZ - bhz) tem o texto: "Schedulr was unable to open the prodsked file for the following reason: "!1"." Em portugues: "schedulr was incapaz to open the prodsked arquivo for the seguinte motivo: "!1".". Temas: arquivo nao conseguiu. Em outras palavras: O agendador não conseguiu abrir o arquivo de produção devido ao motivo indicado na mensagem.. Explicacao oficial: Some possible reasons are that the file has been locked, or the user running schedulr does not have the rights to open it.

**Perguntas Frequentes / Casos de Uso:**
- O que significa a mensagem AWSBHZ008E no HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8?
- Qual o texto e a severidade da mensagem AWSBHZ008E?
- Como diagnosticar a mensagem AWSBHZ008E?

## [hwa-msgcat-awsbhz015e] Troubleshooting & Mensagens de Erro
**Contexto:** [Escopo: HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 > Componente: bhz > Interface: mensagem AWSBHZ015E > Topico: troubleshooting > messages [awsbhz015e]]

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBHZ015E (severidade: error, familia AWSBHZ - bhz) tem o texto: "Schedulr encountered the following error while trying to lock the mastsked or job.sched databases: "!1"" Em portugues: "schedulr encountered the seguinte erro while trying to lock the mastsked or job.sched databases: "!1"". Temas: erro job. Em outras palavras: O agendador falhou ao tentar bloquear os bancos de dados de agendamento para uso exclusivo.. Explicacao oficial: See message. These databases are locked before schedulr starts selecting the job streams that are to be included in the production period. Schedulr might not be able to lock the mastsked and job.sched databases because the databases might be locked by another process.

- Qual o texto e a severidade da mensagem AWSBHZ015E?
- Como diagnosticar a mensagem AWSBHZ015E?

## [hwa-msgcat-awsbia272w] Troubleshooting & Mensagens de Erro
**Contexto:** [Escopo: HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 > Componente: composer > Interface: mensagem AWSBIA272W > Topico: troubleshooting > messages [awsbia272w]]

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBIA272W (severidade: warning, familia AWSBIA - composer) tem o texto: "The specified "tcpaddr" value "!1" is not in the range 1 to 65535. The following value of "!2" is used instead, calculated as the modulus of the input value divided by 65536." Em portugues: "the especificado "tcpaddr" valor "!1" is nao in the range 1 to 65535. the seguinte valor of "!2" is used instead, calculated as the modulus of the entrada valor divided by 65536.". Temas: nao especificado valor. Explicacao oficial: The supplied TCP/IP port number is out of range. A default value has been calculated using the modulus of your input value divided by 65536 (the modulus is defined as the remainder left after the input value has been divided by 65536 the maximum integral number of times). For example, if you input a port value of 300001 (which is greater than 65535), the program divides it by 65536 an integral number of times (4), giving a remainder of 37857. This remainder is called the modulus, and is used as the port value.

**Contexto:** [Escopo: HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 > Componente: composer > Interface: mensagem AWSBIA297E > Topico: troubleshooting > messages [awsbia297e]]

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBIA297E (severidade: error, familia AWSBIA - composer) tem o texto: "The job stream, or the workstation on which it runs, cannot be renamed because another job stream already exists with the supplied name. Two job streams can only have the same name if one has been created, not renamed, as a version of the other (with different valid-from dates)." Em portugues: "the job fluxo, or the estacao de trabalho on which it runs, nao pode be renamed porque another job fluxo already existe with the informado nome. two job streams can only have the same nome if one has estado created, nao renamed, as a versao of the other (with different valido-from dates).". Temas: nao estacao de trabalho job pode nome informado fluxo versao. Explicacao oficial: A job stream is identified by the job stream name and the workstation or workstation class it is to run on. But different versions of the job stream can exist with different valid-from dates, but only provided they are created as such. An existing job stream cannot be renamed to become a version of another existing job stream.

## [hwa-msgcat-awsbio040e] Troubleshooting & Mensagens de Erro
**Contexto:** [Escopo: HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 > Componente: bio > Interface: mensagem AWSBIO040E > Topico: troubleshooting > messages [awsbio040e]]

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBIO040E (severidade: error, familia AWSBIO - bio) tem o texto: "The supplied job stream alias "!1" cannot be used, because another job stream has been submitted in this plan instance with the same alias." Em portugues: "the informado job fluxo alias "!1" nao pode be used, porque another job fluxo has estado submitted in this plano instancia with the same alias.". Temas: job nao pode informado fluxo plano. Em outras palavras: O alias da job stream informado já foi usado por outra submissão nesta instância de plano e não pode ser reutilizado.. Explicacao oficial: When a job stream is submitted with an alias, the internal ID of the submitted job stream is set to the value of the alias. This is so that follows dependencies can be created where the aliased job stream instances are predecessors. If you subsequently submit the same or a different job stream, using the same alias, the software detects the duplication and does not submit the job stream, issuing this message.

**Perguntas Frequentes / Casos de Uso:**
- O que significa a mensagem AWSBIO040E no HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8?
- Qual o texto e a severidade da mensagem AWSBIO040E?
- Como diagnosticar a mensagem AWSBIO040E?

---

## [hwa-msgcat-awsbio041e] Troubleshooting & Mensagens de Erro
**Contexto:** [Escopo: HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8 > Componente: bio > Interface: mensagem AWSBIO041E > Topico: troubleshooting > messages [awsbio041e]]

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBIO041E (severidade: error, familia AWSBIO - bio) tem o texto: "The job cannot be submitted because the job or job alias "!1" already exists." Em portugues: "the job nao pode be submitted porque the job or job alias "!1" already existe.". Temas: job nao pode. Em outras palavras: O job ou o alias dele já existe no sistema, impossibilitando a nova submissão.. Explicacao oficial: When a job is submitted, the program checks to see if a duplicate job or duplicate alias already exists in the Symphony file. The program follows these rules: Two jobs without aliases cannot exist with the same name, irrespective of whether they were put in the plan by planner or by a normal submission to the current plan. Two aliases cannot exist with the same name, irrespective of whether they were supplied explicitly, or generated by the program. The program only generates an alias if you are: a) performing an ad-hoc submission, b) the job name already exists, and c) an alias has not been supplied. The program uses the docommand string of the job as the alias. This means that if the program has already created an alias for a job with a given docommand string, it cannot create an alias for any job that has the same docommand string. The job cannot be submitted because the alias is a duplicate.

Explicacao oficial: The Yellow Pages is a centralized database of files including the passwd, group, and other system files. Users can also have the same password across the network.

**Instrução Técnica / Resolução:**
No HCL Workload Automation 10.2.8, a mensagem AWSBIY001W (severidade: warning, familia AWSBIY - biy) tem o texto: "Running the sample database setup deletes all job streams and jobs with the prefix "SMPL" from the database." Em portugues: "em execucao the sample banco de dados setup deletes all job streams and jobs with the prefix "smpl" from the banco de dados.". Temas: job banco de dados. Em outras palavras: Executar a configuração do banco de dados de exemplo apaga todos os jobs e fluxos de jobs com o prefixo de exemplo existentes.. Explicacao oficial: The sample database contains a set of scheduling objects to be used in the tutorial. These objects are all identified by the presence in the object name of the prefix SMPL. When you install the database, it automatically deletes any previous objects with the same prefix that it finds. This allows you to easily replace the database after you have used the tutorial and modified the objects (provided that you did not modify the prefix).
